newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP could liquidate oil assets - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP could liquidate oil assets - paper.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) has said it would liquidate its petroleum assets if it could not generate adequate returns over the next three years, The Australian newspaper reported on Thursday.

BHP Petroleum chief executive John O'Connor told a briefing on Wednesday that his division was two years into a five-year programme of expansion, but stressed that if the programme was not successful then he would protect shareholder value by increasing the asset disposal programme, the newspaper said.
O'Connor said BHP Petroleum had a three year deadline to get decent exploration progress or "we'll cut back on exploration and then you just have a prolonged liquidation scenario."
"We want, first, shareholder returns," O'Connor was quoted as saying. "That may require slow growth or liquidation," he said. BHP's shares closed down 13 cents at A$17.55 on Wednesday.
